description: Source code for a Thread class implementation managing thread creation, control, and lifecycle in a cross-platform manner (Windows and POSIX). It includes thread initialization, termination, suspension, priority management, and exception handling.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: A cross-platform thread management class supporting thread creation, control, and lifecycle management with exception handling and priority settings.

methods.name: Thread
methods.description: Constructor initializing thread with optional stack size and name, creating platform-specific thread.

methods.name: ~Thread
methods.description: Destructor that terminates the thread safely.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Send a signal to the thread (Linux-specific).

methods.name: StartThread
methods.description: Static method to start thread execution, platform-specific.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Gracefully stops the thread and waits for it to finish.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the thread (POSIX) or sets suspended state.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for thread to reach specified state within timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Gets or sets the current thread state.

methods.name: GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves call stack for debugging (debug mode).
